proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item UnitRecord variant
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts only covers spell | class_feature | mastery. No magic_item variant exists in the TypeScript surface despite magic_item_root appearing in the v4 taxonomy atom inventory. A new top-level record type (MagicItemRecord) and at least one mechanics family are required before any magic item can be encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Rare — the source unit is of kind magic_item, which has no corresponding UnitRecord branch

proposed_widenings.name: spell_via_charges MagicItemMechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core pattern is: spend a charge (and a Magic action) to cast a specific named spell. This is structurally distinct from all existing spell families (the item is not itself a spell being cast by a caster) and from ClassFeatureMechanics (no class, no class level, no rest reset). A new mechanics family is needed to express 'item holds a stored spell and releases it per charge consumed'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can strike the chime to cast Knock.

proposed_widenings.name: charge resource with permanent depletion (no recharge, item destroyed on exhaustion)
proposed_widenings.justification: UseCountResource requires a RestResetCadence variant. The Chime of Opening has a fixed charge pool (10 uses) that never refills — the item cracks and becomes useless when exhausted. No RestResetCadence variant covers 'never; item is permanently destroyed.' This is categorically different from the existing short/long-rest patterns.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The chime can be used 10 times. After the tenth time, it cracks and becomes useless.

notes: The magic_item_root source atom exists in TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md v4 but the corresponding UnitRecord kind has not yet been added to types.ts. Three gaps block encoding: (1) missing MagicItemRecord type/kind, (2) missing mechanics family for spell-via-charge items, (3) missing non-rechargeable permanent-depletion charge resource variant. The sound substitution ('ringing tone instead of knock sound, audible 300 ft') is purely cosmetic/caller-owned narrative and does not require new atoms — it would belong in the description field only.
